trigger.title: EStateTreeTransitionTrigger
trigger.description: When to try trigger the transition.

requiredEvent.title: StateTreeEventDesc
requiredEvent.description: Defines the event required to be present during state selection for the transition to trigger.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

bConsumeEventOnSelect.description: If set to true, the event is consumed (later state selection cannot react to it) if state selection can be made.

temporaryEvent.title: StateTreeEvent
temporaryEvent.description: Temporary event used as a source value in bindings.

_structType.description: UScriptStruct path name for polymorphic type identification (e.g. /Script/Module.StructName).

origin.description: Optional info to describe who sent the event.

name.description: Name of the state at the time of linking, used for error reporting.

iD.description: ID of the state linked to.

linkType.title: EStateTreeTransitionType
linkType.description: Type of the transition, used at edit time to describe e.g. next state (which is calculated at compile time).

fallback.title: EStateTreeSelectionFallback
fallback.description: Fallback of the transition if it fails to select the target state

iD.description: Globally unique identifier in 8-4-4-4-12 hyphenated form, e.g. "E05FCC13-4D37-9D7A-E238-83859F29AD74".

delegateListener.title: StateTreeTransitionDelegateListener
delegateListener.description: Listener to the selected delegate dispatcher.

priority.title: EStateTreeTransitionPriority
priority.description:
Transition priority when multiple transitions happen at the same time.
During transition handling, the transitions are visited from leaf to root.
The first visited transition, of highest priority, that leads to a state selection, will be activated.

bDelayTransition.description: Delay the triggering of the transition.

delayRandomVariance.description: Transition delay random variance in seconds.
